node.title: Count root-exceptional children of a maximal constant three-pencil
node.statement: For full-gcd1 shared V dimension4 of actual degree D, regular W dimension5 and a maximal constant three-pencil S with no constant4, let E>=2 be the primitive scalar degree of S. Every regular child outside the common roots of S is rank-two3/3 with a constant plane; every exceptional child has direction S and primitive degree E. There are at most D-E exceptional finite coordinates. For N>=A>D and nonnegative child bounds C,U(E), Omega<=((N-D)*C+(D-E)*(U(E)-C)_+)/(A-D). No normalization or characteristic guard is required. A constant4 parent instead has every regular child whole constant3.
